label: Café building and service polish
new: An envelope Inbox shows compensation letters and reasons for 14 real days after delivery.
Select starter walls one tile at a time, with per-tile prices and thin gray outlines. Existing saves, doors and windows stay intact.
Stove work tiles are reserved and marked red.
Settings now has a Log panel with copyable save diagnostics without save contents or full profile identifiers.
fixed: Improved mobile toolbar and Help typography, Build and Tiles spacing, shorter action text, and the Staff Done button.
Corrected door jambs, arm layering and vertical rest poses, and crisp, centered character bubbles.
More natural bites, food portions that shrink as guests eat, visible leftovers, and better seated table and leg proportions.
Restored street-end walkers and pedestrian density.
Waiters drop off dishes; cleaners wash each plate in 20 game seconds. Each sink holds up to six plates.
Meals pay 200 coins, core-team wages total 50 coins per game minute, and new Basic oak sets cost 280. Historical costs and refunds stay intact.
Guests get angry after 70 game seconds and leave unpaid at 120 if their meal is not prepared. Anger lasts until food reaches them.
Cleaners skip blocked floor-cleaning tasks so reachable work can continue.
Corrected receipt layering on rear-facing registers.
The Welcome title, greeting and skip hint now fade together.
Browser saves can recover from a closing database connection by reopening the same database and rechecking the profile and revision before one retry.
